sentences: Multi-step constant calculations on SGPRs (`s_mov_b32`, `s_lshl_b32`, `s_lshr_b32`, `s_mul_i32`, `s_add_u32`, `s_sub_u32`, `s_lshl1..4_add_u32`, `s_bfe_u32/i32`, `s_min/max_u32/i32`, `s_andn2/orn2/nand/nor/xnor_b32`, `s_abs_i32`, `s_absdiff_i32`, `s_sext_i32_i8/i16`, `s_pack_*_b32_b16`, `s_bfm_b32`) fold completely at translation time and record folded literal values in `self.sgpr_imm`, allowing downstream instructions within the basic block to propagate constants.
`s_buffer_load` offset expressions computed via constant SALU fold statically into 64-bit addresses, and in-bounds reads eliminate runtime bounds check branches and Phi nodes.
`s_bfe` with constant control words emits static offset/width operands directly.
